units.source_text: 且说内大臣家那一位女公子，即希望当尚侍的那位近江君，由于此种人习癖所使然，近来热衷于恋情，春心动荡不定。

en.t: Now, the young lady of the Inner Minister's household, Omi no Kimi, who hoped to become Naishi no Kami, had lately become absorbed in love affairs because of her nature, and her heart was restless and unsettled.
The Inner Minister was deeply troubled by this.

units.source_text: 弘徽殿女御也担心她做出轻薄行为来，时时刻刻提心吊胆。

en.t: The Kokiden Consort also feared that she might behave frivolously, and was anxious every moment.

units.source_text: 内大臣曾经制止她：“今后你不可到人多的地方去。”

en.t: The Inner Minister had once restrained her, saying, "From now on, you must not go where many people gather."

units.source_text: 但她不听，依旧常常往人多处去。

en.t: But she would not listen, and as before she often went to crowded places.

units.source_text: 有一天，不知道是什么日子，许多殿上人聚集在弘徽殿女御那里，而且都是声望特别高贵的人。

en.t: One day, for some occasion or other, many courtiers gathered at the Kokiden Consort's quarters, all of them men of especially noble reputation.

units.source_text: 他们合奏管弦，优雅地按拍唱曲。

en.t: They played wind and string instruments together and sang elegantly in time with the beat.

units.source_text: 时值凉秋，暮景清丽，宰相中将夕雾也来参与雅集。

en.t: It was cool autumn, the evening scene was clear and beautiful, and Yugiri, the Consultant Captain, also came to join the refined gathering.

units.source_text: 他此次和往常不同，随意说笑，毫无顾忌。

en.t: This time, unlike usual, he talked and laughed freely, without the least reserve.

units.source_text: 众侍女都认为难得，赞道：“夕雾中将毕竟与众不同啊！”

en.t: The ladies-in-waiting all thought it rare and praised him, saying, "Captain Yugiri really is unlike anyone else."

units.source_text: 此时近江君挤开众人，钻进人群中来。

en.t: Just then Omi no Kimi pushed people aside and forced her way into the crowd.

units.source_text: 众侍女说：“啊呀，不得了，怎么办呢？”想拉住她。

en.t: The ladies-in-waiting cried, "Oh no, this is terrible, what shall we do?" and tried to hold her back.

units.source_text: 但她狠狠地向她们瞅一眼，昂然直入。

en.t: But she shot them a fierce glance and strode proudly straight in.

units.source_text: 众侍女相与交头接耳地告道：“你们看着，她又要闹笑话了。”

en.t: The ladies-in-waiting whispered to one another, "Just watch, she is going to make herself ridiculous again."

units.source_text: 近江君指着那个世间少有的诚实君子夕雾，极口赞道：“这个人好，这个人好！”

en.t: Omi no Kimi pointed at Yugiri, that rare and honest gentleman, and praised him extravagantly, saying, "This man is good, this man is good."

units.source_text: 喧哗之声连帘外也听得清楚。

en.t: The noisy commotion could be heard clearly even outside the blinds.

units.source_text: 众侍女正在叫苦，近江君用非常爽朗的声音吟道：

en.t: As the ladies-in-waiting were lamenting in distress, Omi no Kimi recited in a remarkably bright, ringing voice:
